text:
maria: Starting a short thread to lock alpha gates for 'Observe Hub' deliverable. Scope suggestion: one consolidated console page (summary + per-route rows), runtime trace tags, sampled cost rollups, and error-slice alerts for two pilot customers. Need owners + clear launch checks.
devon: Pilot orgs = NorthStar (prod) and ClinicX (staging). NorthStar needs per-route daily snapshots for billing; ClinicX needs automated alerts on model.route error spikes.
sylvia: From infra: default telemetry retention should be 7d for alpha. Full traces only when error=true or when QA forces capture. We can enable 30d behind an enterprise flag later.
noah: UX: we'll produce a single "Hub" page with a compact table of routes and sparklines + a small drill panel with up to 3 example traces. No freeform dashboard editing for alpha.
maria: Engineering asks: which tags are required on spans? devon?
devon: Minimal tag set: model.name, route.id, org.id, token_count, quant_mode. Emitted as lightweight metadata only. Sampling default 1% and error_force_capture=true. We'll also support header X-RW-DEBUG-SAMPLE for QA. Example pseudo:```go
func emitMeta(req) {
  meta := map[string]string{"model": req.Model, "route": req.Route, "org": req.Org} 
  meta["tokens"] = strconv.Itoa(req.TokenCount)
  if shouldSample(req) { sendTrace(meta) }
}
```
sylvia: Important infra constraint: span metadata packets must be <300 bytes and batched to reduce producer RPCs. Topic retention 7d, pilot full-trace cap 10k/day.
noah: Product asks: an "estimate now" quick-action would be helpful — compute per-request estimate using model.profile + token_count prior to call. We can show it in-row and for CSV exports.
billing-bot: billing-bot: created export-schema v1 -> fields: route_id, window_start, requests, total_tokens, est_cost. Export access: org-admin only.
maria: Launch acceptance proposal (vote):
  1) Hub page visible to pilot orgs and populated with sampled telemetry
  2) Runtime emits required span tags and token_count for pilot traffic
  3) On-demand estimator endpoint available and shown in UI
  4) Admin CSV export for 7d rollups exists (no PII)
  5) Error-slice alerts configurable and firing in pilot test harness
  6) Canary plan + rollback runbook documented in ops playbook
  7) Perf: median overhead <1% for pilot traffic, p99 degradation <3%
sylvia: Canary plan outline: enable feature-flag for 2% of NorthStar traffic in us-east-1; monitor median latency, CPU, telemetry lag. Roll back if median latency delta >1% sustained for 10m or if telemetry lag >45s for 15m.
devon: I'll own the runtime PRs and ensure batching + size checks. I'll add a checklist: feature-flag gate, span-size tests, telemetry unit tests, perf bench job.
noah: I'll own UI + estimator integration. UX will include a short explainer line about sampling and why numbers are estimates.
billing-bot: billing-bot: export flag "observe_hub_alpha_export" created and scoped to admin roles.
maria: Quick tradeoff note: we won't ship full custom dashboards or long-term retention in alpha. Those will be backlog items. Is everyone ok with that cut?
sylvia: Works for infra. We get to measure sizing before committing to longer retention.
devon: Fine. We'll capture enough traces on errors to validate attribution math. For cost attribution we will run a nightly reconcile job for alpha to compare sampled-estimates vs billing. Aim for <10% error.
maria: Final: locking scope as above. Owners to file micro-RFCs with acceptance tests and perf bench plan by EOD Thursday. Sync Tuesday 10am to review canary metrics and mocks. :thumbsup:
